ticket.title: Make the gaugeblock suite gates installable in CI
ticket.description: CI runs the cargo gates and the no_std target build, but miter audit, miter deps and chalkline docs check cannot run there: the tools are built from local sibling checkouts under ~/dev2026/neurosymbolic-suite and are not on crates.io, so a runner has no way to obtain them. The suite-gates job exists but is disabled so the omission is visible rather than implied coverage. Close by publishing the tools or by documenting a git-based install pinned to a release tag, then flip the job on.
